purpose: Durable progress record for the Jastrow/Krupnik meaning-equivalence audit.

baseline.realReaderPhraseExtractorAudit: all 589 retained mappings passed the last completed Chromium audit; the latest 24-pair tranche is awaiting validation.
baseline.distinctSensePolicy: preserve distinct senses; never merge by headword or token overlap alone
baseline.sourcePolicy: each accepted mapping must be grounded in original source records and exact reader-displayed phrases

historicalCheckpoint.note: The earlier 29/43 checkpoint did not record the 43 candidate identifiers or the 29 completed identifiers. Do not infer completion from the number of data shards or from the reviewed-pair count.

reconstruction.note: These physical shard counts do not equal the historical 43 audit batches. The candidate inventory must be regenerated from shared consonantal headwords, original glosses, and the real reader phrase extractor.

rules: Generate candidates only where Jastrow and Krupnik records share an attested consonantal headword or alias.
Use only phrases emitted by JastrowReadingView.phrases for Jastrow-side meanings.
Compare individual senses, not whole-entry summaries.
Exclude exact-identical glosses already handled by ordinary exact matching.
Record every candidate as pending, accepted, rejected-distinct-sense, or rejected-not-displayed.
Keep original source references and exact source wording for every decision.
Candidate discovery uses token overlap only to rank a review queue; it never automatically merges senses.

candidateInventory.status: generated; 5,528 candidates remain pending human review after filtering already-reviewed pairs, explicit grammatical-label conflicts, pointed-headword conflicts, and active/passive infinitive mismatches
candidateInventory.note: The first full-corpus run used the real reader phrase extractor and original Krupnik glosses. It is a discovery queue, not an equivalence certification.

reviewedTranche.note: Three manually reviewed tranches added 108 unique source-pair mappings after the 505-pair baseline. Five earlier attempted candidates were excluded when the real reader extractor did not emit the proposed phrase. The latest 24-pair tranche is awaiting its CI audit.
